title: Weekly Market Review
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-on week; metals and semis exploded higher. Rate-sensitive tech led after a weak July jobs report crushed September hike odds, while defensives and oil lagged badly. The dominant driver was a sharp repricing in rate expectations, with silver +9.82% and SOXX +7.60% as the stars.

INDICES — QQQ +5.09%, SPY +3.51%, IWM +3.56%, DIA +2.92%. Large beat small by 1.53pp. VIX fell to 14.9, below its 20-day of 17.2. Silver led cross-asset at +9.82% WTD, gold +7.25%, while oil dropped 0.75% on Friday. All indices hold above 200-day MAs.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +7.20%, XLB +4.82%, XLY +3.25%, XLI +2.97%, XLC +2.78%, XLV +1.93%, XLF +1.16%, XLP +0.08%, XLRE -0.20%, XLU -1.67%, XLE -3.44%. Top Industries: GDX +21.31%, SILJ +20.96%; bottom: XOP -6.20%, USO -8.66%. Money flooded into rate-sensitive tech and metals, exited energy and defensives. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

DRIVERS — Semis and precious metals dominated: GDX volume 2.5x average, SILJ 2.4x, GLD 2.0x. Software earnings drove single-stock moves — PLTR +10.32%, MP +7.62% on earnings, plus Atlassian and Cloudflare strength. July jobs report showed 23,000 job losses versus 80,000 expected, crushing September hike odds and lifting S&P 500 to a record close. Energy sold off as oil eased on potential US-Iran Hormuz reopening.

WHAT'S NEXT — Watch whether silver's +9.82% run continues given GVZ and OVX data are unavailable — monitor SLV at its 54.5 gamma flip for positioning squeeze potential. QQQ's PCR_vol of 1.31 signals heavy put skew that could unwind into strength. VIX at 14.9 with gamma flip at 770 for SPY suggests rangebound pressure next week unless momentum extends.
